title: 投资经典：段永平的投资哲学 — Day 37

questions.question: 有人持有的公司基本面已明显恶化，他说：「我修的是平常心，价格涨跌都不动。」按段永平的「平常心」，这算吗？
options: 不算：平常心是把锚换回基本面，基本面恶化还拿着就是价值陷阱
算：平常心就是不被市场波动牵动，长期持有本身正是这项纪律
算：只要最初买入时看懂了生意，之后的变化都不该影响持仓决定
不算：平常心要求在股价下跌时逐步加仓，只拿不动还是不够坚定
questions.explanation: 平常心不是心如止水，也不是麻木，它把定价的锚从别人的报价换回生意基本面，所以基本面真的变了就该动。「长期持有本身就是纪律」最诱人，却把一种行为当成了原则；逆向也不等于越跌越买。
questions.question_en: Someone holding a company whose fundamentals have clearly deteriorated says: "I'm cultivating an ordinary mind; I don't move whether the price rises or falls." By Duan Yongping's idea of the "ordinary mind" (pingchangxin), does this count?
options_en: No: the ordinary mind moves your anchor back to fundamentals, and holding through their decline is a value trap
Yes: the ordinary mind means not being moved by market swings, and long-term holding is itself the discipline
Yes: as long as you understood the business when you bought, later changes shouldn't affect the position
No: the ordinary mind requires adding gradually as the price falls, and merely holding isn't resolute enough
questions.explanation_en: The ordinary mind isn't stillness or numbness; it moves the anchor for pricing from other people's quotes back to the business's fundamentals, so when the fundamentals truly change, you should act. "Long-term holding is itself the discipline" is the most tempting option, but it mistakes a behavior for a principle; being contrarian also doesn't mean buying more the further it falls.

questions.question: 段永平在网易濒临退市、股价低于每股现金时重仓，后来涨了 50 多倍。普通投资者应该从中学什么？
options: 学背后的认知深度，不学集中度：集中是看懂之后的结果，不能先验模仿
学逢低买入的规则：股价一旦跌破每股现金，就是可以重仓的安全信号
学极致集中的打法：分散只会摊薄收益，看好的机会就应当重仓押注
学逆向操作的胆量：众人踩踏时越跌越买，下跌本身就是在送上礼物
questions.explanation: 他敢重仓的前提是真看懂生意、现金又能等，同样的打法押错一次就是本金归零，而我们记住的是幸存下来的那一笔。低于每股现金是当时的具体情形，不是通用规则；下跌也可能正是基本面恶化的信号。
questions.question_en: Duan Yongping took a large position in NetEase when it was close to delisting and trading below cash per share, and it later rose more than 50-fold. What should an ordinary investor learn from this?
options_en: The depth of understanding behind it, not the concentration: concentration follows from understanding and can't be copied up front
A buy-the-dip rule: once a stock falls below cash per share, that's a safe signal that you can take a large position in it
The extreme-concentration playbook: diversification only dilutes returns, so bet heavily on the opportunities you like
Contrarian nerve: buy more as it falls while the crowd stampedes out, because the drop itself is a gift being handed to you
questions.explanation_en: He dared to go big because he truly understood the business and had cash that could wait; the same play, wrong once, means losing all your principal, and what we remember is the one bet that survived. Trading below cash per share was the specific situation at the time, not a general rule; a drop may also be the very signal that fundamentals are deteriorating.

questions.question: 怎样判断一条投资信条（比如「本分」）是真纪律，而不只是心灵鸡汤？
options: 看它是否经过大师几十年的长期实践，并被多家成功企业传承过
看它能否让自己在市场波动时保持情绪稳定，持仓时不再感到焦虑
看它能否解释自己过去的每次盈亏，解释得越圆融说明理解越深
看它能否生成可勾选、可违反的具体禁令，比如「遇到 X 就退出」
questions.explanation: 分水岭在能否证伪：生成不了具体动作的多半是情绪安慰。「能解释所有盈亏」恰恰是鸡汤的特征，事后无论赚赔都能自圆其说；大师传承也不算标准，那正是要警惕的导师光环和幸存者偏差。
questions.question_en: How can you tell whether an investing creed (such as "benfen," staying within your proper role) is real discipline and not just feel-good fluff?
options_en: Whether it has had decades of practice by a master and been passed down by several successful companies
Whether it keeps your emotions steady during market swings, so that you no longer feel anxious holding positions
Whether it can explain each of your past gains and losses; the neater the explanation, the deeper your understanding
Whether it can generate specific prohibitions you can check off or violate, such as "if X happens, exit"
questions.explanation_en: The dividing line is falsifiability: what can't generate a concrete action is mostly emotional comfort. "Can explain every gain and loss" is precisely the mark of fluff, since it justifies itself after the fact whether you win or lose; being handed down by a master isn't a criterion either, because that is exactly the mentor halo and survivorship bias to watch out for.
